record.quote: People with type 1 diabetes (T1D) also have a high need for new kidney- and cardiovascular-protective therapies. Most published trials of new drugs for diabetes and CKD (including incretin mimetics, SGLT2i, and nonsteroidal mineralocorticoid antagonists) have excluded people with T1D. Recommendations for use of these new drugs do not apply to people with T1D, leaving clinicians with few treatment options.
